newsitem.title: USA: Costa Rica negotiating for 26,500 T rice - trade.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica negotiating for 26,500 T rice - trade.

text.p: Costa Rican millers were privately negotiating with exporters on Tuesday for 26,500 tonnes of optional origin long grain rough rice, several U.S. exporters and traders said.
"They are directly negotiating with prospective vendors outside of formal tender status," one U.S. exporter said.
Results were expected by the end of the week, he added.
The shipment period was set for June 30-June 7 with the quality specified as U.S. No. 2 grade minimum 54/68 milling outturn or Argentine rice, another source said.
